pages.text: Say it with me. $(item)Wyrm$(). $(item)Milk$().$(br2)Yes yes. It is weird we know. It will all make sense when you get to experience the wonder and might of the $(item)World Wyrms$().$(br2)For now, let us just focus on the task at hand.$(br)$(item)Wyrm Milk$() is made out of 4 vital components. 3 of them being liquids, and one of them being a solid.

pages.title: молоко червя Components
pages.notes: $(item)Growtein$().$(br)$(item)Pure Calcium$().$(br)$(item)Subterranean Nutrient Distillation$() (or SND for short).$(br2)In addition to these 3 liquids. You will also need a metric shit-ton of $(item)Rich Slag$(). You might currently be short on $(item)Rich Slag$() supply, but after you have your very own $(item)World Wyrm$(), you won't be.

pages.text: The new alloys you constructed from $(item)Silicon$() has enabled you to craft some new fancy machines.$(br2)$(item)The Vat$() can create a myriad of new liquids.

pages.title: Pure Calcium
pages.text: Made by distilling the $(item)Softened Quicklime$() from the $(item)Silicon$() production.$(br2)When distilled in a $(item)Vat$() with $(item)Calcified Mineral Soil$() and $(item)Life Essence Marrow$(), you will start to produce $(item)Pure Calcium$().$(br2)$(item)Calcified Mineral Soil$() is made from bone mealing $(item)Moist Mineral Soil$().

pages.title: Growtein
pages.text: $(item)Protein$() is very important for most living beings, especially the $(item)World Wyrms$(). You can produce protein from a $(item)Protein Reactor$().$(br2)Of course $(item)Protein$() does not just appear from thin air and electricity, so you will have to supply it with some type of meat/flesh.$(br)We recommend using fish.

pages.title: Growtein
pages.text: Hopefully you now have several of the $(item)Protein Reactors$(), and you are using speed/energy upgrades.$(br2)Once you have protein, you can turn it into Growtein by distilling it in a Vat with some $(item)Primal Nature$().$(br2)The growtein will aid the wyrms growth exponentially!

pages.title: SND, Step 1
pages.text: $(item)Subterranean Nutrient Distillation$() is a multi-stage $(item)Vat$() process.$(br2)You start by using the $(l:sim_5/resources/2_deep_substrate_water)mineral rich water$() you found in the $(item)Mineral Quarry$() pocket dimension with some $(item)Dragon Nests$() and $(item)Mushrooms$().$(br)This turns the $(item)Глубоководный субстрат$() into $(item)Nutrient Distillation$().

pages.title: SND, Step 2
pages.text: On the 2nd pass you infuse the $(item)Nutrient Distillation$() with $(l:sim_5/resources/1_minerals_and_ores#subore)Fine Kalthrite Coating$() and $(item)Alien Subterranean Dust$() turning it into the SND.$(br2)The $(item)Alien Subterranean Dust$() is made from the $(l:sim_4/resources/2_ores#rouxecrystal)Rouxecrystals$() you found in the midnight pocket dimension, infused with $(item)Resonant Ender$().

pages.title: Fluid Mixing
pages.notes: Mixing these 3 fluids together is no small feat.$(br2)You will need to construct a $(item)Dark Steel Fluid Mixer$() that is capable of mixing together the $(item)Wyrm Milk$().$(br2)Pull up $(l:portal_hub/4_schematica)Schematica$() to see the bill of materials. We have listed the important ones at the top of the page.
